header.function_name: XD07 IF Cross Dock Master to AP POLE

objective: To send the cross dock master of the parts waiting for synchronisation to AP POLE: Active parts with Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date and all destinations with Case/Day of the ongoing period. Parts that became Inactive are sent with CROSSDOCK_FLAG 'N' (one record, no destination): AP POLE deletes the part at part level in Cross Dock Kanban Part Master (same as [Delete] on AP POLE screen WLM9Q890) (decided 30-Oct). Source: Part List (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE) and Part Mapping per Destination (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST).

Interface method: interface file by SFTP, Option #3 of 'NSP Cross Dock Interfacing Data': NSP Send IF -> TMMIN SFTP -> TMA SFTP -> receive IF (TMA) -> AP POLE master. SFTP details, file format and the AP POLE tables are not detailed in this document.
A part is sent as one complete set; AP POLE replaces the data of the part, so a change such as Philippines up and Thailand down, or a removed destination, arrives as one consistent update.
The send status per part is kept in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT (dummy table); together with XD06 (GTOPAS) it gives the overall Sync Status shown on the Cross Dock Part Master screen (XD01).

interface file by SFTP, Option #3 of 'NSP Cross Dock Interfacing Data': NSP Send IF -> TMMIN SFTP -> TMA SFTP -> receive IF (TMA) -> AP POLE master. SFTP details, file format and the AP POLE tables are not detailed in this document.

nodes.label: SFTP put to TMMIN SFTP server, verify
Send status per part, overall Sync Status, history

steps: [Sync] on XD01 sets the parts to Waiting (SYNC_STATUS = '3' in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE, IF_STATUS = '3' for 'APPOLE' and 'GTOPAS' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT) and starts XD07. Write LOG1.

steps.text: Select the parts with TARGET_SYSTEM = 'APPOLE' and IF_STATUS = '3' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT. Keep CHANGED_DT of each part.
children: PART_STATUS Active: sent with its destinations (CROSSDOCK_FLAG 'Y').
PART_STATUS Inactive: sent with CROSSDOCK_FLAG 'N' so AP POLE deletes the part.
No part: write LOG2 and exit.

steps.text: Create the interface file XD_CDMASTER_APPOLE_<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>.csv in the outbound folder (see Interface File / Interface Data):
children: Per part: PART_NO, CROSSDOCK_FLAG 'Y', PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
Per destination of the ongoing period: PERIOD, DEST_CODE, CASE_DAY from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST (one record each).
Inactive part: one record with PART_NO and CROSSDOCK_FLAG 'N'; the other fields of the part and destination are blank.
Same SEND_ID and SEND_DT on every record. Error: LOG3, all parts Failed (step 6).

steps.text: Put the file by SFTP on the TMMIN SFTP server (outbound folder) and verify the transfer (file size / record count). The file is forwarded to the TMA SFTP server, where the receive IF of the TMA inserts / updates Crossdock Kanban Part Master and Crossdock Export Part Master (AP POLE).
children: Transfer error: retry (parameter); still failing: LOG4.
Transfer OK: move the local file to the backup folder.

steps.text: Set the send status of every part of the file in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT:
children: Transfer OK (file on the TMMIN SFTP server): IF_STATUS = '1', IF_DT = now, IF_FILE_NAME = file name, IF_MESSAGE blank.
File or transfer error: IF_STATUS = '2', IF_DT = now, IF_MESSAGE = error (LOG3 / LOG4).
The status is the result of the SFTP transfer.

steps.text: Update the overall Sync Status of each part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and record the history:
children: CHANGED_DT differs from step 2 (part changed while sending): SYNC_STATUS = '0' (No Sync).
Else, status of 'APPOLE' and of 'GTOPAS' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT: one still '3' -> SYNC_STATUS stays '3'; both '1' -> '1' (Success); one '2' -> '2' (Failed, SYNC_MESSAGE = target + reason).
SYNC_DT = now when SYNC_STATUS becomes 1 or 2.
Insert TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE: event SYNC, source IF, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, REMARK = 'APPOLE: ' + result / message.

steps: Write LOG2 with the file name and the number of parts / records sent. Exit.

items: The D/S team maintains the cross dock master on XD01 (Part List: Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date; Mapping per Destination: Case/Day per destination of the ongoing period, created by XD05 process 2 and adjusted by screen or upload XD03).
Every change sets the part to No Sync. The D/S team clicks [Sync] when the changes are complete; Active parts and parts that became Inactive are sent; Candidate parts are not.
AP POLE replaces the cross dock master of every part in the file with the content of the file (all destinations of the part).

Interface method: interface file by SFTP, Option #3 of 'NSP Cross Dock Interfacing Data': NSP Send IF -> TMMIN SFTP -> TMA SFTP -> receive IF (TMA) -> AP POLE master. SFTP details, file format and the AP POLE tables are not detailed in this document.

Parts that became Inactive (XD05 process 1) are sent with CROSSDOCK_FLAG 'N' and without destinations: the receive IF of the TMA deletes the part (one row per part number) in Cross Dock Kanban Part Master (same as [Delete] on AP POLE screen WLM9Q890) (decided 30-Oct). GTOPAS deletes all their rows too (XD06, RPA).
Fields, source and business rule: see Interface Data (General Description). The field names on the side of the target follow the target layout.
Sum of CASE_DAY of the records of a part = MAX_CASE_DAY (guaranteed by XD05 and the save checks of XD01 / XD03).
PERIOD is always the ongoing period; past periods are never sent.
TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT is a dummy table that keeps the send status per part and target; the real output of XD07 is the interface file sent to AP POLE.

Overall SYNC_STATUS: Waiting while a target is Waiting, Success when both targets are sent, Failed when one target failed (the next [Sync] sends the part again to both targets; repeatable, AP POLE gets the complete set again).
A part changed on XD01 or by upload while it is being sent gets SYNC_STATUS = No Sync, so the newer data is sent by the next [Sync].
Field names on the side of the target follow the target layout (not detailed in this document).

tables.name: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT
tables.description: Dummy table (proposed): send status of the cross dock master per part and target system (XD06 GTOPAS, XD07 AP POLE). The real output is the interface data sent to the target (AP POLE: file by SFTP; GTOPAS: RPA). The overall Sync Status of the part stays in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
columns: Calculation period of the mapping sent (YYYYMM)
Date-time of the result of the target system
Name of the interface file (AP POLE) or RPA input file (GTOPAS)
Reason when Failed; blank when Success
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: Candidate part setting, one record per part (Part List data, no calculation period). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Minimum MAD (mandatory); reference compared with the MAD result of the calculation
Effective start date; required while the part is Candidate
Date-time of the last IF function result
Reason of the last Failed sync
Upload that last changed the record
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST
tables.description: Destination mapping, one record per part, calculation period and destination (Mapping per Destination data). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Calculation period, YYYYMM e.g. 202609; displayed as Sep 2026
Destination code (buyer code + PD code, 7 digits); exists in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION (Destination Master)
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). Read by the History setting modal of Part List (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). No retention limit: the history is kept (no housekeeping job, decided 30-Oct).
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC / CALC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (IF batch user ID for SYNC, batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change
